description: This file defines the MediaTokenService class, which implements token-based security for media processing URLs in OrchardCore. It handles adding tokens to paths, parsing query strings, and validating tokens using hashing and caching mechanisms.

classes.name: MediaTokenService
classes.description: A service class responsible for generating, caching, and validating security tokens for media URL processing in OrchardCore.

methods.name: AddTokenToPath
methods.description: Adds a security token to the media URL path based on query parameters.

methods.name: ParseQuery
methods.description: Parses query string into known command parameters and other parameters.

methods.name: TryValidateToken
methods.description: Validates a token against a collection of commands.

methods.name: CreateQueryStringTokenKey
methods.description: Creates a cache key string from query parameters for hashing.

methods.name: CreateCommandCollectionTokenKey
methods.description: Creates a cache key string from command collection for hashing.

methods.name: GetHash
methods.description: Generates a hash for a given key, caching the result.

methods.name: AddQueryString
methods.description: Constructs a URL with appended query parameters using a span-based approach.
